pole_design_assessment.qualified_reason: The homogeneous recurrence y[n]=−a1*y[n−1]−a2*y[n−2] has denominator z²+a1*z+a2. For actual finite real same-slot a1/a2 with a2>0 and a1²<4a2, its positive conjugate root angle is atan2(sqrt(4a2−a1²),−a1), radius sqrt(a2). This distinguishes a damped/discretized denominator pole from nominal w/fs. This review did not evaluate the expression or derive any frequency value.
pole_design_assessment.required_future_evidence: Actual rounded same-slot coefficients, fs/control/state interval, active processing path/lane, numerator/nonzero-residue observability and an independently justified output/error model remain needed. Arm64 source must also be related to the actual x86 reference state before claiming a reference observation. No nominal-frequency or unrounded-source approximation is an approved substitute.
